title: Axios #7421: RangeError Maximum call stack when JSON.stringify on AxiosError with circular ref

error_signal.message: axios RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded when calling JSON.stringify on AxiosError toJSON with circular reference from cancelToken

ground_truth.root_cause_description: AxiosError.toJSON includes config which references back to the error via cancelToken.reason, creating a circular reference that crashes JSON.stringify.
ground_truth.fix_description: Break circular reference in toJSON by excluding self-referencing properties
